descriptors.description: Descriptor axes defining the MAP-Elites behavioral grid. Each descriptor maps a metric to binned coordinates. Out-of-range values produce special bin tokens ('unknown', 'under', 'over') rather than clamping to edge bins.

DescriptorConfig.description: Configuration for a single MAP-Elites descriptor axis. Values outside [min, max] produce special bin tokens: 'under' (below min), 'over' (above max), or 'unknown' (null/non-finite). In-range values are binned into [0, bins-1].

id.description: Metric id used as the descriptor axis. Must match a known metric name from the evaluation pipeline.

min.description: Lower bound of the in-range bin interval. Values below this produce the 'under' bin token.

max.description: Upper bound of the in-range bin interval. Values above this produce the 'over' bin token. Must be greater than min.

bins.description: Number of uniform bins for in-range values. Produces bin indices [0, bins-1].
